question: He gave himself one hour to build an AI video editor. How long did it actually take?

updates.state: Timer returns as 'ACTUAL BUILD TIME', digits scrambled, STATUS: ENCRYPTED
Chip 'REVEALED AT THE END' on 'I will tell you in the end of the video'

question: How does the editor actually work?
object: The raw-footage monitor in the pipeline panel

updates.state: Real waveform loses its dead space: 1:41.6 -> 0:45.1

resolution: POST pressed -> POSTED; called back at 'the video you're watching right now is edited by this editor' with this video's real cut list
supportingSpeech: you put in your video, raw video, then AI analyzes it ... then it's done. Post it.

opening.benefit: Watch someone race a self-imposed one-hour deadline to build an AI video editor, and see how it works
opening.evidenceBy3: By 0:03 the 1:00:00 timer has lit up and is visibly counting down, with an 'AI VIDEO EDITOR' target chip
